title: The Case of the Bottled Ship
story: On Monday morning the library's prized ship in a bottle, the *Constance*, was gone from its glass case. In its place sat a short length of rope tied in a neat bowline, borrowed from the knots display. Over the weekend, five volunteers each dusted one display with a different duster, and Wren whispers that she would like her ship back before story hour, please. Who moved the ship in a bottle?

question.text: Who moved the ship in a bottle?
